note: Caris SP (Soshage zh-tw 220) : traduction non officielle depuis le chinois. Termes officiels repris de Soshage EN par id (Defensive Ward, Piety, Piety Bonus, Potential Burst, Instant, Auxiliary Passive, ▲Crit II...). Skills 4504, 4015, 4001, 4512, 4158, 4222, 4226 : texte anglais officiel (autres persos).

trait.name: Sanctuary of True Love
base: Gains the skill [Crescent Sanctuary]. At the start of battle, gains [Steadfast Faith]. After actively healing, dispels 1 random [Debuff] from the target ally and grants them 1 stack of [Defensive Ward] for 2 turns.
Has a special [Piety Bonus]. When [Piety] increases, gains the same number of stacks of [Caris's Redemption].

1: Increases max HP and healing by 10%. At the start of the action, [Piety] increases by 20.
2: Increases max HP and healing by 20%. At the start of the action, [Piety] increases by 20. The first time the character receives healing each round, recovers 1 NRG.
3: Increases max HP and healing by 20%. At the start of the action, [Piety] increases by 30. The first time the character receives healing each round, recovers 1 NRG.
The effect granted by the skill [Crescent Sanctuary] becomes [Power of Sanctuary II].
The duration of [Extreme Weakness] is reduced to 4 turns.
4: Increases max HP and healing by 30%. At the start of the action, [Piety] increases by 30. The first time the character receives healing each round, recovers 1 NRG.
The effect granted by the skill [Crescent Sanctuary] becomes [Power of Sanctuary II]. Allies with a [Power of Sanctuary] effect also gain [Potential Burst].
The duration of [Extreme Weakness] is reduced to 4 turns.
5: Increases max HP and healing by 30%. At the start of the action, [Piety] increases by 40. The first time the character receives healing each round, recovers 1 NRG.

The first time [Crescent Sanctuary] is cast, the target gains [Steadfast Faith], and the effect granted becomes [Power of Sanctuary II]. Allies with a [Power of Sanctuary] effect also gain [Potential Burst].
The duration of [Extreme Weakness] is reduced to 3 turns.

22615.name: Light Bestowed
desc: (Passive) After actively healing, grants allies [▲Crit II], [▲Crit DMG II] and 1 stack of [Defensive Ward]; all effects last 2 turns.
Gains an aura: "Papal States" allies within 4 tiles of the character gain an additional 20% Crit and 10% Crit DMG, and gain [Piercing Bonus - Crit].

22616.name: Holy Light Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals Piercing AoE DMG equal to 40% of M.ATK to all enemies within 1 tile of the target, then heals the 1 ally with the lowest HP within 4 tiles of the character for 40% of M.ATK.

22610.name: Radiant Truth
desc: [Auxiliary Passive]: Before actively healing, dispels 2 random [Debuff] from the target; before actively attacking, inflicts [Piercing Vulnerable II] on the target for 2 turns.

22607.name: Blossoming Mercy
desc: (Healing) [Instant] Heals all allies within 2 tiles of the target tile for 40% of M.ATK and grants them [▲P.DEF II] and [▲M.DEF II] for 2 turns.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Increases max HP and healing received by 15%. When casting [Light of Love for All], other allies in its range gain an additional 4 stacks of [Defensive Ward] for 2 turns.

22618.name: Undying Glimmer
desc: (Reaction) After taking DMG, if HP is below 50%, heals self for 100% of M.ATK and gains 10 stacks of [Defensive Ward] (lasting 2 turns). Cooldown: 3 turns after triggering.

22605.name: Thorns of Mercy
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects a direction and deals Piercing AoE DMG equal to 90% of M.ATK to enemies within a 3×6 area; then heals allies in the area for 50% of M.ATK and grants them 1 stack of [Defensive Ward], [▲ATK II], [▲DMG II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns.

22588.name: Light of Love for All
desc: (Healing) Heals all allies within 4 tiles of the character for 30% of M.ATK and grants them 4 stacks of [Defensive Ward], [▲ATK II], [▲DMG II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns; then prepares for 1 turn, after which heals allies in range for 70% of M.ATK. Gains [Extra Effect] during preparation.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of battle, allies in range gain 3 stacks of [Defensive Ward] for 2 turns.

d: (Healing) [Instant] Selects an ally and heals that target and the character for 40% of M.ATK, and grants the target ally [Power of Sanctuary I] (2 turns); then consumes all of the character's [Caris's Redemption] and increases the target ally's [Piety] by the same amount. For every 5 stacks consumed, the target gains 1 stack of [Defensive Ward] (2 turns).
If an ally with a [Power of Sanctuary] effect is in battle, this skill can target the character: its effects are applied to that ally, who is teleported next to the character.
While active, if [Piety] is below 0, it increases by 20. Removed after triggering.
When the skill [Crescent Sanctuary] is cast, grants extra effects based on the number of stacks.
Includes [Power of Sanctuary I] and [Power of Sanctuary II].
Increases healing received; after taking DMG while [Injured], is healed by the caster.
Only 1 can exist in battle; applying it again removes the oldest one.
When upgraded to [Power of Sanctuary II], reduces the NRG cost of the first skill cast each round.
The first skill with a cost cast each round costs 1 less NRG.
Increases healing received by 20%.
After taking DMG, if [Injured], is healed by [Caris SP] (ignoring distance) for 50% of her M.ATK. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.
Only 1 of this effect can exist in battle; applying it again removes the oldest one.
While affected, the skill [Light of Love for All] does not grant its [Extra Effect] during preparation.
Adds 20% of Crit and Crit DMG to Piercing DMG. This effect increases Piercing DMG by up to 20%.
The next time a [Healing] skill or a skill dealing [Piercing DMG] is actively used, ATK and Piercing DMG are increased by 60%. Removed when the skill ends.

(Healing) Heals all allies within 4 tiles of the character for 30% of M.ATK and grants them 4 stacks of [Defensive Ward], [▲ATK II], [▲DMG II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns; then prepares for 1 turn, after which heals allies in range for 70% of M.ATK. Gains [Extra Effect] during preparation.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of battle, allies in range gain 3 stacks of [Defensive Ward] for 2 turns.
Extra effect of [Light of Love for All], during preparation:

Gains Unyielding: when triggered, recovers 5% HP and immediately releases the prepared effect; [Piety] decreases by 10 and the character suffers [Extreme Weakness] for 5 turns (reduced as star level increases).
Gains an aura: allies in range take 20% less DMG, and [Caris SP] shares 50% of the DMG taken by other allies in range (100% if they have a [Power of Sanctuary] effect).
